title: Cardio-Diabetes PRC (promotional review with maker-checker certification)
summary: Five roles (brand manager, MLR coordinator, medical, legal and regulatory reviewers) with reviewers scoped to their own reviews, a reference library and reviewer roster synced from the HR directory, materials with versions, claims substantiated one by one against a reference page, parallel medical, legal and regulatory reviews within an SLA, regulatory certification with job code, 24-month expiry and recertification, certified PDFs pushed to a document management system, and material and reference 360 pages.
